_comment: Copy this to .claude/settings.json yourself to grant the pipeline's permissions. Claude is deliberately not allowed to install this file: a human grants permissions, not the agent. 'mcp__n8n' allows every tool of the n8n MCP server; 'mcp__supabase' allows every tool of the Supabase MCP server (added Nov 14, 2026 at Tristen's explicit request, after the B05 builder could not apply its own migration); the Bash/PowerShell entries let headless planner/builder runs use git, node, npm and npx without stalling on prompts.
